Why choose FrigAirco

  • Fast response

    A cooling breakdown cannot wait. We answer the phone and WhatsApp at any hour and arrange the visit as quickly as possible.

  • Certified engineers

    F-Gas certified technicians and an approved company: your equipment is in qualified hands and compliant with regulations.

  • Over 10 years of experience

    From cold rooms to chillers, from bar fridges to heat pumps, we know the equipment and its faults, whatever the brand.

  • Businesses and homeowners

    Restaurants, butchers, bakeries, food shops, industry and offices, as well as houses and apartments.
